map.隐患排查清单生成工具：按行业与作业场景结构化生成隐患排查清单，覆盖检查项、风险等: Hazard checklist generation tool: generates structured hazard inspection checklists by industry and work scenario, covering check items, risk levels and closed-loop correction records, to support enterprise safety management.
map.按作业类型（用电、消防、登高、受限空间等）生成隐患排查清单，逐项检查并标注风险等: Generate hazard inspection checklists by work type (electrical, fire, working at height, confined space and so on), check item by item and mark the risk level.
map.对发现的隐患评定高/中/低级别，制定整改措施、责任人与期限，形成闭环跟踪。: Rate identified hazards as high/medium/low, set correction measures, owners and deadlines, and form closed-loop tracking.
map.统计闭环率 = 已整改数 / 隐患总数，用于安全绩效评估。: Closure rate = number corrected / total hazards, for safety performance assessment.
map.：风险等级按可能性×后果评定：高（立即停工整改）、中（限期整改）、低（纳入日常监: : Risk level is rated by likelihood x consequence: high (stop work and correct immediately), medium (correct within a deadline), low (include in routine monitoring). Closure rate = number of hazards corrected and closed / total hazards x 100%; those overdue and uncorrected count as not closed and are escalated.
map.：某车间排查出 12 项隐患，其中高 2、中 5、低 5；已整改闭环 9 项（高: : A workshop found 12 hazards, of which 2 high, 5 medium and 5 low; 9 have been corrected and closed (2 high, 4 medium, 3 low), so the closure rate = 9/12 = 75%; the remaining 3 (1 medium, 2 low) are overdue and must be escalated for supervision.
map.隐患排查清单生成与闭环管理: Hazard checklist generation and closed-loop management
map.隐患和事故是什么关系？: What is the relation between hazards and accidents?
map.隐患是可能导致事故的不安全状态或行为，整改隐患是预防事故的前置手段；闭环率低说明: A hazard is an unsafe state or behaviour that may lead to an accident; correcting hazards is the front-line means of preventing accidents, and a low closure rate indicates weak management and rising accident risk.
map.高风险隐患必须停工吗？: Must work stop for high-risk hazards?
map.高风险（如漏电、可燃气体泄漏）应立即使相关区域停用并整改，验收合格方可恢复，不能: High-risk hazards (such as electric leakage or flammable gas leaks) require the affected area to be taken out of use immediately and corrected, with work resuming only after acceptance; operating with the hazard present is not allowed.
